Position Overview
Details of the Division and Team:
Deutsche Bank’s Trade Finance and Lending (TF&L) business is a significant division within the Corporate Bank that specializes in providing comprehensive financing solutions to support corporate’s activities through a comprehensive set of products such as Documentary Trade, Supply Chain Finance, Corporate Loans, Project Finance, Natural Resource Finance and Structured Trade and Export Finance.
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced professional to join our Core Trade Finance and International Lending (Core TFIL) team within the TF&L business at Deutsche Bank. Core TFIL is a dedicated unit holistically responsible for identifying, developing, structuring and successfully delivering bespoke client solutions and customized products across Core TFIL areas (Documentary Trade, Working Capital, Lending). In addition, the unit has a mandate to develop new products and client solutions to drive revenue by working closely with the existing structuring teams and risk functions, corporate coverage, all 2nd-line functions and product management. The Core TFIL area is particularly important in the development and global provision of tailor-made financing solutions.
The role is responsible for developing strategy and performing business development for trade finance, supply chain financing, corporate loans, and structured debt solutions for large corporate clients.
What we will offer you:
A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce are better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its centre.
You can expect:
Supplemental Savings Plan on top of mandatory social security
20 days of annual paid leave, plus public holiday & Flexible Working Arrangement
A range of competitive benefits to suit your needs
On-line family doctor consultation for both employee & family members
Employee Assistance Program for both employee & family members
Key responsibilities:
Drive revenue growth, portfolio quality and client engagement for the Core Trade Finance and International Lending business. The role is responsible for developing strategy and performing business development for trade finance, supply chain financing, corporate loans / lending and structured debt solutions for large corporate clients.
Responsible for providing strategic leadership to a team of product specialists and RMs, fostering a high performance, collaborative and client centric culture.
Identify market opportunities and develop innovative product propositions aligned with client needs and business strategy.
Ensure sound risk management while partnering closely with Coverage, Risk, Operations and Product teams.
Originate, structure, and execute flow and complex trade finance and lending transactions, including working capital, supply chain finance, receivables finance, structured trade, and cross border financing solutions. Prior origination and transaction structuring experience with large cap corporate clients with headquarters in China.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to originate financing business and build senior client relationship.
Deep understanding of credit, trade finance and credit products, risk management, regulatory requirements, and Greater China Banking landscape.
Your skills and experience:
12 years or more of experience in core trade finance, lending, and structured credit solutions within an international or regional financial institution
Proven track record in originating, structuring, and executing core trade finance, lending and structured credit solutions for multinational corporations and large local corporates
Track record of leading a high performing team
Strong expertise across full suite of credit solutions, core trade finance and lending products, and extensive experience in structuring secured and unsecured lending facilities
Demonstrated ability to structure bespoke financing solutions and strong credit analytical skills
Sound understanding of transaction risk, counterparty risk and non-financial risk
Proven business development capability with an established set of corporate clients in Mainland China and Hong Kong
Experience leading negotiation on transaction structuring and documentation, with strong leadership capability
Fluent in both Mandarin and English, with the ability to conduct business negotiations and manage client relationships in both languages
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.
How We’ll Support You
Flexible working to assist you balance your personal priorities
Coaching and support from experts in your team
A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
Training and development to help you excel in your career
About us and our teams:
Deutsche Bank is the leading German bank with strong European roots and a global network. click here to see what we do.
Deutsche Bank & Diversity:
We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

Established in 2007, FIL Technology (Dalian) Limited was the Fidelity’s first wholly owned enterprise in China. The Dalian office initially served as a systems development centre to bolster Fidelity’s growing business in the Asia Pacific region, with a primary focus on providing technology and web-based support and services. team

Sustainable Investing Solutions team

Strong analytical and research skills with the ability to interpret corporate filings and governance documents.

Data analytical and automation skills (Python/SQL/PowerBI), experience of developing automation for business processes is highly preferred. Experience as Project Manager, Business Analyst, SME is a strong plus.
Proficient in using AI tools to improve efficiency, ensure accuracy, and solve business problems.
Highly efficient English communication skills, both written and verbal is mandatory.
Demonstrated learning ability and interest in Investment knowledge. CFA, FRM related certificate is highly preferred.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, and highly developed teamwork skills
Global stakeholder management and global collaboration model experience is required. Proven record to manage stakeholder and deliver high quality work under pressure.
A good team player with open-minded, flexible and positive attitude for changes.
Self-disciplined and self-motivated to drive business result with a clear career plan.

For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. HSBC Qianhai Securities Limited (HSBC Qianhai), a joint venture securities company, was incorporated on 28 August 2017, pursuant to Supplementary Agreement X to the Closer Economic Partnership Arrangements (CEPA) between the mainland and Hong Kong.
The registered capital of HSBC Qianhai is RMB1.8 billion. The Hong Kong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited (HSBC) holds 90% of the shares, while Qianhai Financial Holdings Co., Ltd. (QFH) holds the remaining 10%. Our headquarters are located in Qianhai, Shenzhen. We have branch offices in Beijing and Shanghai, and a trading outlet in Qianhai, Shenzhen.
By combining solid expertise in the domestic capital market with the global competitive advantage of the HSBC Group, we are committed to providing our customers with comprehensive securities services and a diverse range of products, aspiring to be your unique partner in China's onshore capital markets.
Our purpose – ‘Opening up a world of opportunity’ – explains why we exist. For information about our purpose and values, please visit HSBC.com.
HSBC Qianhai is part of one of the world’s largest financial services organisations. Whether you are an experienced professional, looking for your first job, or are interested in one of our student and graduate programmes, we provide many ways for you to develop your skills and achieve your career ambitions in a diverse and inclusive environment.
We offer opportunities across our organisation to build a fulfilling career and work with colleagues and customers around the world. We have roles available in business areas including Investment Banking, Securities Brokerage, Investment Advisory, Securities Proprietary Trading, Asset Management and Private Wealth Management, and Functions, Digital Business Services.
We look for people who are ambitious and want to develop their career and contribute to HSBC’s long-term, sustainable growth. We want employees who can help us achieve our strategy, balance social, environmental and economic considerations and manage risk accordingly.
To ensure we achieve this growth in the right way, we place great emphasis on our values. We are committed to applying the highest standards throughout the company, everywhere we do business.
Diversity and inclusion is at the heart of our business. Joining HSBC will give you the opportunity to work in a collegiate and supportive environment in which we seek to develop and promote you based on merit.
We also have a strong commitment to sustainability and encourage employees to participate in our community projects and other activities.
The role background
As part of the China Technology Research team, the Research Associate will support fundamental equity research across technology sectors through company analysis, financial modelling, industry deep-dive and research publications.
We are looking for a highly curious and analytical research analyst with strong independent judgement, intellectual integrity and a high sense of ownership. The ideal candidate embraces new technologies and research methodologies while maintaining rigorous thinking, professional ethics and high standards of compliance.
Experiences of investment research (Sell or Buy side), strategy & accounting, consulting might be preferred.
Responsibilities Of The Role Holder
Fundamental Research
Conduct company and industry research, build and maintain financial models and analytical frameworks, analyse business fundamentals and competitive dynamics, and contribute to high-quality research publications in both English and Chinese.
Research Excellence
Leverage data, technology and modern research tools to improve productivity and deepen analysis. Evaluate information critically, verify sources independently, and translate complex problems into clear, evidence-based investment insights.
Analytical Thinking
Approach research with curiosity and intellectual rigor. Challenge assumptions, distinguish signal from noise, and develop differentiated views supported by sound analysis and evidence.
Professionalism & Collaboration
Maintain high standards of integrity, confidentiality and compliance. Work effectively across a broad research platform, collaborating with analysts, Sales, Corporate Access and other stakeholders while demonstrating ownership, accountability and a strong team-first mindset.
Preferred Candidate Profile
Intellectual Curiosity
Naturally curious with a passion for learning. Enjoys understanding how businesses, technologies and industries evolve, and continuously seeks better ways to improve research quality.
Integrity & Ownership
Demonstrates solid judgement, intellectual honesty and a strong sense of ownership. Takes responsibility for outcomes, follows through on commitments, and earns trust through professionalism and accountability.
Strong Analytical Foundation
Strong financial modelling, accounting and valuation skills with excellent attention to detail. Proficient in Excel, PowerPoint and Word, with working knowledge of Bloomberg and/or Wind. Comfortable working with large datasets and modern analytical tools; experience with advanced data analysis tools is an advantage.
Communication & Teamwork
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Mandarin. A collaborative team player who communicates well and is willing to share , welcomes constructive debate and contributes positively to the success of a broad research platform.
Location: Beijing/Shanghai/Shenzhen, China

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Assistant Manager.
Principal responsibilities
The jobholder will be a member of the Business Analytics within Business Finance and Reporting team, providing management information and analytical support to the Global Head of Business Finance and Reporting. Key activities include the preparation of business management papers, reviewing and challenging external reporting results including forecast projections, and driving transformation initiatives around the financial planning processes, among others
Reporting Review: Support the review and challenge of the IFRS 17 results, including participation in governance forums to provide Group advice and challenges to financial analysis and management actions.
Forecasting Analytics: Support the analysis, interpretation, and development of solutions for Management Information to provide business insights and implications, including but not limited to budgeting and forecasting.
Result Communication and Consolidation: Fully understand the IFRS 17 reporting results from local entities and support the formulation of a Group ‘story’ around the numbers. Assist in the preparation of Group management information packs summarizing actuarial reporting results and project outcomes for various stakeholders.
Methodology and Basis Review: Support the review and challenge of the reasonableness of actuarial approaches, methodologies, assumptions, simplifications, and any actuarial judgments applied in IFRS 17 reporting to ensure compliance with the underlying IFRS 17 policies, controls, and risk framework, including participation in basis review committees.
Stay Informed: Keep abreast of developments and changes in accounting policies, methodologies, and processes to support an early assessment of IFRS 17 results impacts, strengthen SOX controls, and improve documentation around the production process.
Market Awareness: Stay informed about market practices, new topics discussed by industry discussion groups, and/or market surveys/statistics conducted by consultants and regulatory bodies.
Requirements
Experienced, qualified actuary with recognised professional body (e.g. IFoA, SOA).
Minimum 5 years of experience in financial reporting, with a proven track record within life insurance companies or consultancy firms,
Strong actuarial knowledge of IFRS17, familiar with the end-to-end reporting methodology, assumption, process, control and governance.
Strong writing and presentation skills, with expertise in presenting and producing high quality reports at governance forums.
Experience prophet modelling and/or understanding to finance system and accounting rule is an advantage.
